verdict.rationale: AI inbox triage is a fair axis for an email client, but the evidence pack has no first-party AI auto-labeling, categorization, or attention-surfacing feature. The cited material covers only adjacent developer building blocks: Graph APIs for defining categories, setting Inbox rules, flagging, and filtering. These let a developer construct triage but are not AI triage the product performs. The only Copilot mention is a community comment about copy-pasting, not about inbox triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
